newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends slightly lower.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed slightly lower after a lightly traded session.
Traders said hedge selling from the slight increase in farmer selling of grain may have contributed to the decline, but the light volume made it hard to assign a clear reason.

Leading sellers included Peavey with 600,000 bushels of May and Country Hedging with about 700,000 of March. Cargill Investor Services led buyers with about 700,000 March, while Benson Quinn bought 600,000 March and sold 400,000, traders said.
MGE wheat closed down 1-3/4 to 1/2 cent per bushel with March off 1-1/2 at $3.80-1/2.
Estimated spring wheat volume was 9.25 million bushels.
